description:
Two parallel mutagen efficacy studies on Phoenix/Ecto apps (atlas, builder)
independently discovered the same bug:

When `mix mutagen` runs via the global archive install (wrd.40), it does not
start the consumer project's OTP application before running tests. Currently
`ensure_runtime/0` only calls `Application.ensure_all_started(:mutagen_ex)`.

This breaks any test that requires:
- `Atlas.Repo` / `Builder.Repo` running (Ecto Sandbox checkout)
- `Mox.Server` (`import Mox`)
- `Phoenix.PubSub` (broadcast/subscribe)
- Supervised GenServers (`Builder.TraceStore`, atlas stream workers)

**Impact:**
- builder: 6 of 14 candidate tickets aborted at baseline; ~76% of builder's
  test surface is currently unreachable to mutagen.
- atlas: worked around with a 12-line `Mix.Tasks.MutagenApp` shim that calls
  `Mix.Task.run("app.start")` before delegating to `mutagen`. Also has to call
  `Mix.Local.append_archives()` between the two because `app.start` clears
  the archive search path.

Structurally the same shape as wrd.40: runtime preamble assumes more host
state than is actually present. The wrd.40 fix taught the preamble to find
its OWN ebin; this ticket should teach it to start the consumer project's app.

## Proposed fix

- After `Mix.Task.run("compile")` in `ensure_runtime/0`, call
  `Mix.Task.run("app.start")`.
- If `app.start` clears the archive code path, follow it with
  `Mix.Local.append_archives()` to re-add.
- Add an opt-out flag (`--no-host-app` or env var) for libraries that
  explicitly want a minimal boot — the mutagen_ex self-test sandbox uses the
  minimal boot, so the opt-out matters.

## Evidence

- Atlas study: ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/reports/atlas/2026-05-18-efficacy-study.md
  (Finding 1 in TL;DR, Method §4 — the MutagenApp shim is at
  /Users/mz/dev/mz/atlas-mutagen-study/lib/mix/tasks/mutagen_app.ex)
- Builder study: ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/reports/builder/2026-05-18-efficacy-study.md
  (TL;DR, Method §6 — 6/14 baseline aborts documented)
- Cross-project synthesis: ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/reports/mutagen_ex/2026-05-18-cross-project-synthesis.md
  (Finding 3 — flagged as the highest-leverage adoption blocker)

## Acceptance

- `mix mutagen --scope <lib_file> --tests <test_file>` runs cleanly against
  a Phoenix/Ecto project with `DataCase`/`ConnCase`/Mox/PubSub tests.
- Integration test in the wrd.40 style: a `archive_install_phoenix_test.exs`
  that spins up a minimal Phoenix project, installs the archive, and runs
  mutagen against a Repo-backed module.
- Opt-out path verified by re-running the mutagen_ex self-mutation Lab
  sandbox (which must continue to work with the minimal boot).

INVESTIGATION: archive :telemetry boot bug is PRE-EXISTING (not a 1jx regression)

I rolled back to base commit 36ccbb1 (the epic/3fa parent — predates this
ticket entirely) and ran the archive_install_test on the original code.
Identical failure:
  {:error, {:telemetry, {~c"no such file or directory", ~c"telemetry.app"}}}

So the archive_install_test has NEVER been green. mutagen-1jx did not
break it.

Root cause:
- mutagen_ex declares `:telemetry` as a runtime dependency (mix.exs:73).
- `mix archive.build` does NOT bundle deps by Elixir's design
  (see `mix help archive.build`: "archives do not include dependencies").
- The test's host project is built by `mix new --sup <name>` — no `:telemetry`
  in its deps, so telemetry beams are nowhere on the code path.
- `Application.ensure_all_started(:mutagen_ex)` fails because :telemetry
  must start first and its .app file can't be found.
- The runtime preamble's existing archive repair (`add_first_mutagen_archive_ebin`
  + `Mix.Local.append_archives()`) only locates the mutagen_ex archive
  ebin — it doesn't help :telemetry because :telemetry was never bundled.

Concrete fix scope (small, one-shot):
- Add a custom `archive.build` alias in mix.exs that vendors
  `_build/<env>/lib/telemetry/ebin/*` into the mutagen_ex archive's ebin
  alongside mutagen_ex's own beams. The archive becomes self-contained
  (both `mutagen_ex.app` and `telemetry.app` live in the same archive
  ebin). The existing repair logic then loads both apps automatically.
- No runtime code change in `lib/mix/tasks/mutagen.ex` needed —
  `Mix.Local.append_archives()` already does the right thing for a
  vendored ebin.
- Plus: commit the worker's path-collision WIP (test/integration/*).

Recommendation: one of the two paths below.

(a) Widen mutagen-1jx scope to include the archive.build alias fix.
    Rationale: r16's host_app gate cannot actually be validated end-to-end
    without archive-install working at all. This is one cohesive ticket.

(b) /descope archive_install witness (v11) from mutagen-1jx; file a new
    P1/P2 ticket "Vendor :telemetry into mix archive build" under
    epic/3fa. Close 1jx on the unit + downstream_integration coverage
    (which are sound).

I lean (a) — the bundling fix is small, contained to mix.exs (~15-30 LOC
alias), and was always implicit in the wrd.40 "archive-install adoption
blocker" framing. Without it, mutagen_ex archive installs are broken
period, regardless of whether host-app start is wired up.

collision the auditor flagged and is sound — confirm green with
`mix test --include downstream_integration` after committing.
